title: ALBA: A European Portuguese Benchmark for Evaluating Language and Linguistic Dimensions in Generative LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating open-ended text generation using the ALBA benchmark and an LLM-as-a-judge framework to measure models' proficiency in European Portuguese (pt-PT) and their tendency to systematically default to the higher-resource Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR) or English-centric lexical, morphological, and syntactic patterns.

Assessing models' comprehension and generation of culturally embedded knowledge using the 'Culture-bound Semantics' dimension of the ALBA benchmark, which tests the ability to recognize and properly use proverbs, idiomatic expressions, and regionalisms intrinsic to European Portuguese culture.
